content: Řebni n l’iman x dsas nican
A aytma, necc war zemmareɣ ad kiwem ssiwřeɣ am iwdan inni iddaren ɛlaḥsab Arruḥ, maca am yinni iddaren ɛlaḥsab aysum n bnadem waha, amecnaw iseyman di Lmasiḥ.
Aqa wciɣ awem ad teswem aɣi, war iǧi d ařeqqim imten, minzi tuɣa war d as tzemmarem, ař i řexxu u war d as tzemmarem ɛad,
s minzi kenniw ɛad deg weysum. Maɣar mařa din ɛad jar awem řeḥsed d imenɣan d umsebḍi, ma war teǧim ɛad n ddat niɣ teggurem ɛad deg weysum?
Minzi mařa ijjen zzaywem iqqar: ‘Necc aqa ayi zi Bulus!’ u wenneɣni iqqar: ‘Necc aqa ayi zi Apullus!’, ma xenni kenniw war teǧim ca ddat?
Maɣar min iɛna Apullus u min iɛna Bulus? Aqa aten mɣir d imsexxaren i zi tdewřem tumnem, uca kuř ijjen am mammec d as iwca SIDI.
Aqa necc ẓẓuɣ, Apullus issu, maca AREBBI isseɣmi.
Xenni wenni itteẓẓun war iǧi d ca uřa d wenni ittessun, maca AREBBI wenni issɣemmayen.
Maca wenni itteẓẓun d wenni ittessun d ijjen, waxxa kuř ijj tekkar as-dd řmunet nnes am mammec řxedmet nnes.
Minzi neccin d imsexxaren ak-d AREBBI uca kenniw d tafeǧaḥt d řebni n AREBBI i teǧam.
Ɛlaḥsab arḍa n AREBBI i d ayi immewcen, necc, am řemɛeǧem abennay amiɣis, ggiɣ dsas u wenneɣni ad xas ibna. Ejj kuř ijj ad iḥḍa mammec xas i ɣa ibna.
Minzi uřa d ijjen war izemmar ad igg dsas nneɣni x wenni immarsen, aqa-t d Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Uca mařa ibna ḥed x dsas nni s wureɣ, nnuqart, iẓra iɣřan, tefřawt. řum niɣ s uxecxuc,
řxedmet n kuř ijjen ad tban, minzi ass ad tt isscen. Minzi s timessi ad ittwasseḍhar mammec teǧa řxedmet n kuř ijj, timessi ad tt tfarz.
Mařa teqqim řxedmet n řebni i xas tuɣa ibna ca n ijjen, aqa netta ad iṭṭef řmunet nnes,
u mařa tecmeḍ řxedmet n ca n ijjen, aqa netta ad yarbu taxessart nnes, maca netta simant nnes ad injem axmi ikka timessi.
Ma war tessinem ca belli teǧam d zzawect n AREBBI uca belli Arruḥ n AREBBI izeddeɣ daywem?
Mařa yareyyeb ḥed zzawect n AREBBI, AREBBI ad t yareyyeb, minzi zzawect n AREBBI, tenni teǧam kenniw, tqeddes i teǧa.
War ttejji ḥed ad ixeddeɛ ixef nnes! Mařa din ḥed jar awem ittɣiř as ixef nnes d amiɣis di ddunect-a, ejj i-t ad idweř d abuhaři maḥend ad yiři d amiɣis.
Minzi tiɣit n ddunect-a teǧa d tubbuheřya ɣar AREBBI, minzi tura:
“Iṭṭef imiɣisen s teḥraymect nsen!”,
uca ɛawed:
“SIDI issnen aqa ixarriṣen n imiɣisen d řbaṭeř.”
S uya, uřa d ijjen war issemɣari ca zeg iwdan, minzi marra nwem,
ma d Bulus, niɣ d Apullus, niɣ d Kifa, niɣ d ddunect, niɣ d tudart, niɣ d řmewt, niɣ d iḍa niɣ d tiwecca, aqa marra nwem,
maca kenniw n Lmasiḥ uca Lmasiḥ n AREBBI.
